sources.source: CSEW police force area estimates, year ending December 2025
sources.verified_fact: Released 23 April 2026, the file provides police-force-area estimates with confidence intervals for local-police perceptions, confidence in police and councils, personal and household crime risk, and anti-social-behaviour experience.
sources.quality_effect: Adds subnational survey context while requiring confidence-interval interpretation and forbidding police-force-area estimates from being converted into parcel probabilities.

sources.source: Drug misuse in England and Wales: year ending March 2025
sources.verified_fact: Released 11 December 2025, the latest accredited release reports CSEW estimates on illicit-drug prevalence, frequency, characteristics and access; estimates for year ending March 2021 and March 2022 are unavailable because of the pandemic.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national survey context with a pandemic-series gap; prevalence and characteristics are not local incidents, parcel probabilities or individual inference.

sources.source: User guide to crime statistics for England and Wales: March 2025
sources.verified_fact: The official guide documents CSEW and police-recorded-crime interpretation, changing survey samples and question wording, including new local-policing attitude questions introduced in April 2024 on half the survey sample.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a mandatory method and denominator gate before combining survey, perception and police-recorded evidence across periods.

sources.source: Police recorded crime and outcomes open data tables
sources.verified_fact: The page was updated 23 April 2026 and includes outcomes open data for year ending March 2026 alongside revised offence, outcome, VAWG, transferred-or-cancelled and Community Safety Partnership tables.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a current outcome-table version guard while keeping outcomes, transferred records and offence totals separate from incident severity and parcel safety.

sources.verified_fact: The official distribution record was updated 8 July 2026, is licensed under the Open Government Licence and supplies street-level crime and neighbourhood-policing data from forces in England and Wales.
sources.quality_effect: Adds distribution, licensing and provenance evidence for the existing Police.uk input without double-counting the same underlying street records as a second score source.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
CSEW police-force-area estimates require confidence intervals and are not parcel probabilities.
Drug-misuse CSEW estimates include a pandemic-series gap and are not local incident counts.
Survey question, sample and denominator changes must be checked through the ONS user guide.
Outcomes, transferred records and offence totals remain separate evidence classes.
Street-level distribution metadata supplies provenance and licensing, not a second independent score input.
No existing candidate score or stored parcel value was modified.

release_gate.source: Crime in England and Wales: year ending March 2026
